delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental delivery of features and early validation of requirements, reducing risk and enhancing alignment with client expectations.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, code generation, and testing, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to ensure quality and relevance. Scope changes will be managed through controlled processes, maintaining project focus and delivery timelines.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations, improve data accuracy, and enhance employee self-service capabilities. This initiative is critical to supporting the company's growth and ensuring efficient management of employee information, attendance, leave, and payroll integration.

Exist Software Labs proposes a cloud-deployed microservices solution built on a modern technology stack including Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL. The system will be delivered through an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a robust, scalable HRIS that meets their operational and strategic needs.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key HR functions such as employee information management, time and attendance tracking, leave management, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. Employees, HR staff, supervisors, and management will interact with the system through role-based access, enabling efficient workflows and self-service capabilities aligned with the client’s operational requirements.

This solution supports the client’s need for accurate data capture, approval workflows, and audit trails, while providing management with insightful dashboards and reports. The system’s design accommodates the client’s organizational structure and policies, ensuring compliance and ease of use across branches and departments.
technical_architecture: The system is architected as a cloud-hosted microservices platform leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend user interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. Integration with the payroll system is handled through secure, auditable data exchanges, ensuring seamless synchronization of attendance and payroll data.

The architecture supports scalability to handle 300 concurrent users with high availability and performance targets. Separate environments for development, testing (UAT), and production ensure quality and stability. Security is enforced through role-based access control, audit trails, and encrypted communications, aligning with the client’s non-functional requirements.
warranty_support: A warranty period will follow system deployment during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed by the project team. Defects can be reported through established channels and will be corrected in a timely manner to ensure system stability and performance.

The warranty covers all functionality delivered as part of the project scope. Support for enhancements, additional features, or issues outside the warranty scope will be offered as separate service options, ensuring ongoing system reliability and client satisfaction.
